title: MeridianCare Sentinel Health RPM Pilot — 9-month snapshot
authors: Lambert, Elise (data generation); Lambert, Joshua E. (analysis)
abstract: Synthetic dataset designed by Prof. Elise Lambert for the 2026-05-22 École des Mines guest session. Models a 9-month Remote Patient Monitoring pilot at MeridianCare Health Network — 250 patients across 6 clinics, four chronic conditions, full engagement + clinical + utilization + cost columns. Generated to be analytically interesting (real site variation, real engagement-outcome correlation) while preserving zero PHI risk.
methodology_summary: Synthetic generation calibrated to plausible distributions for chronic-disease RPM cohorts. ~34% headline ER reduction baked in, with realistic site-level spread (Lakeshore -68%, Westgate ~0%).
population_description: 250 adults with at least one of: Type 2 Diabetes, Hypertension, CHF, COPD. Enrolled across 6 partner clinics in a Pacific Northwest regional system (synthetic).
key_limitations: Synthetic; no causal claims; engagement-outcome correlation does not establish causation; cost assumptions use US averages not contracted rates.
